name: rechtspraak
revision_note: Written AFTER seeing the v1 results, so it is not blind. v1 (rechtspraak-gold.json) is kept unchanged. Changes: the excerpt starts with the court name, date and case number, so year, court and court type are echoed in that field; ruling_words and (for the excerpt) summary_words are real properties of a ruling, not artefacts of the analysed text; more shuffled controls per column.

text_fields.ruling_excerpt: First 2,500 characters of the ruling: header (court, date, case number, parties) and opening text.

court_type.why: Hoge Raad, Raad van State and district courts write differently.

summary_words.why: Length of the analysed summary itself. Cannot be detected beyond length by construction.

ruling_words.why: Full ruling length is a property of the case (criminal judgments run longer). Reported, not scored.

ecli_sequence.why: Running number within court and year. Reported, not scored.

scored_as.primary: every strong column beats every null control on skill beyond length
scored_as.secondary: strong and moderate columns versus null controls (AUC)
scored_as.length: length columns are not detected beyond length
scored_as.unscored: echoed, structure and uncertain columns are reported only
